explanation: Mathlib's GrothendieckGroup.lean only has `of_injective`, `inv_mk`, `mk_div_mk`, `lift` (an Equiv) and `lift_apply`. It has no biadditive `lift₂` and no uniqueness statement for one. I searched Mathlib for GrothendieckAddGroup and GrothendieckGroup and found only that file and three others (Finite.lean, AffineMonoid/Embedding.lean and Mathlib.lean). This theorem is the uniqueness half of the library's own `lift₂`, which is defined on top of `hom_ext₂`. I found no Mathlib declaration that states it.
